info.title: Green Way API
info.description: Generated from backend/src/http/routes.js by scripts/openapi.js. Request and response bodies are described in docs/api.md; validation rules live in the Zod schemas in backend/src/services.

session.name: gw_session
session.description: HttpOnly session cookie set by POST /api/v1/auth/otp/verify. State-changing requests also need a trusted Origin header.

post.x-idempotency: Send an Idempotency-Key header; a retry with the same key returns the original result.

post.description: Raw body. Verified with HMAC-SHA256 (x-razorpay-signature or x-simulated-signature). Duplicate events are acknowledged and ignored.
